_note: Caption bank. lowercase, gentle, short; sad and quietly scary, never gory. Say 'dreams', never 'rooms'. Placeholders: {dream} (dream name), {detail} (the dream's detail line), {count} (number of dreams, from dreams.json), {monster} (the cast name in lowercase words). Max 60 characters after filling. The planner never reuses the same (template, dream, monster, lines) combination and avoids lines used in the last 6 episodes.
hook: you fell asleep in the waiting room.
you open your eyes somewhere soft.
middle: it only knows what it can see.
you could stay a little longer.
turn: something in this dream noticed you.
it was here the whole time.
memory: a memory, glowing in the dark.
someone used to hum this song.
you remember a hand holding yours.
night: the lights went out on the hills.
outro: see you in the next dream.
wave: it waves a little faster now.
